title: Not reading music; Professor Delmo and a Boston teacher
summary: Lewis says he never learned to read music, took two lessons from Professor Delmo, and recalls a Boston teacher's warning.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
